title: Go新goroutine的panic边界：进程崩溃对照与单次失败对账
source: 独立编审：Go特有数据与并发故障
review_note: 现有ID改编；完成情况按精确题目、执行bundle及原生五路证据核对，不以脚本生成认定完成。
rubric: 用类型/栈/字节证据证明根因

conversion.original_title: main中有defer recover，但新worker一次panic仍让整个Go服务退出。如何桌面排查？

body:
## 操作任务
提交package exercise的task.go，实现Outcome{Err error;Panicked bool;Stack string;NeedsReconciliation bool}和RunTask(fn func()error)(<-chan Outcome,error)。nil函数同步返回nil通道和非nil错误；有效任务必须在新goroutine恰执行一次。结果通道缓冲1，发出恰一个Outcome后关闭。正常返回的error原样保留，正常结果Panicked=false、Stack为空、NeedsReconciliation=false；在执行任务的同一goroutine设置defer/recover，任何panic（含nil）转为非nil错误且文本含panic，Panicked与NeedsReconciliation=true并保留debug.Stack，不自动重试有副作用任务。只在启动调用方defer recover不能满足合同；必须实际用子进程证明该错误模式仍致进程异常退出。此包装将独立任务失败交给调用方核对，不保证任意共享状态经panic后安全。

## 提交产物
task.go

## 验收方法
真实子进程错误边界对照，go test -race执行普通返回、普通错误、panic字符串、panic(nil)、副作用单次及结果关闭。

## 能力边界
真实隔离Go进程、实际未捕获worker panic导致子进程非零退出、修复后显式Outcome及-race测试。验证任务入口边界和可核对失败，不保证共享状态修复、外部事务回滚或生产全链路隔离。

test_files.checks/check.py:
import os,sys,pathlib,tempfile,subprocess
assert sys.platform=='linux' and os.geteuid()!=0
print('NATIVE_LINUX_READY',flush=True)
print('STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED: worker panic boundary and crashing child control',flush=True)
env={**os.environ,'GOCACHE':'/tmp/opsforge-go-cache','GOMODCACHE':'/tmp/opsforge-go-modcache','GOTOOLCHAIN':'local','GOPROXY':'off','GOSUMDB':'off','CGO_ENABLED':'1','GOMAXPROCS':'2'}
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='opsforge-go-panic-') as directory:
 root=pathlib.Path(directory);(root/'go.mod').write_text('module opsforge.local/exercise\n\ngo 1.23\n',encoding='utf8')
 (root/'task.go').write_bytes(pathlib.Path('task.go').read_bytes());(root/'task_test.go').write_bytes(pathlib.Path('checks/task_test.go').read_bytes())
 proc=subprocess.run(['go','test','-race','-vet=off','-v','-count=1','-timeout=10s','./...'],cwd=root,env=env,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=100)
 detail=proc.stdout+proc.stderr
 if len(detail)>5000:detail=detail[:4000]+'\n[diagnostic shortened]\n'+detail[-1000:]
 assert proc.returncode==0,'Go worker validation failed: '+detail
 assert 'NATIVE_GO_UNRECOVERED_WORKER_CHILD_EXIT_REPRODUCED' in proc.stdout,'unsafe child control was not executed'
 print('NATIVE_GO_UNRECOVERED_WORKER_CHILD_EXIT_REPRODUCED',flush=True)
print('NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED',flush=True)
